description: Collection of Perishable Data on Wind- and Surge-Induced Residential Building Damage During Hurricane Harvey (TX) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by David Roueche, Auburn University (auburn.edu). Hurricane Harvey made landfall in Port Aransas on August 25, 2017 as a Category IV hurricane. Wind gusts over 130 mph were measured in Rockport, TX before Harvey moved further inland, causing historical flooding in and around Houston, TX. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2DX22. Keywords: hurricane, Harvey, reconnaissance, engineering, damage. Published 2018-08-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
